
```bash
mkdir -p /root/clkc_mech_interp/data/xnli/gemma2
```

```bash

    --lang en \
    --batch_size 4 \
    2>&1 | tee logs/gemma_xnli_en_act.log
```

```bash

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python -u src/collect_activations.py \
    --model /root/autodl-tmp/models/gemma-2-9b-it \
    --data_dir data/xnli/ \
    --output_dir data/xnli/gemma2/ \
```

```bash
    --output_dir data/xnli/gemma2/ \
    --bootstrap_seeds 2000 \
    --langs "en,zh" \

    --skip_permutation \
    2>&1 | tee logs/gemma_xnli_probe.log

```
